RECORDS.description_main: ASUS routers supporting custom OpenVPN profiles are vulnerable to a code execution vulnerability. An authenticated and remote attacker can execute arbitrary operating system commands by uploading a crafted OVPN profile. Known affected routers include ASUS ExpertWiFi, ASUS RT-AX55, ASUS RT-AX58U, ASUS RT-AC67U, ASUS RT-AC68R, ASUS RT-AC68U, ASUS RT-AX86, ASUS RT-AC86U, ASUS RT-AX88U, and ASUS RT-AX3000.

RECORDS.description_main: In Liferay Portal 7.2.0 through 7.4.1, and older unsupported versions, and Liferay DXP 7.3 before service pack 3, 7.2 before fix pack 15, and older unsupported versions the `doAsUserId` URL parameter may get leaked when creating linked content using the WYSIWYG editor and while impersonating a user. RECORDS.description_main:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/amdgpu: fix use-after-free bug

The bug can be triggered by sending a single amdgpu_gem_userptr_ioctl
to the AMDGPU DRM driver on any ASICs with an invalid address and size.
The bug was reported by Joonkyo Jung <joonkyoj@yonsei.ac.kr>.
For example the following code:

static void Syzkaller1(int fd)
{
	struct drm_amdgpu_gem_userptr arg;
	int ret;

	arg.addr = 0xffffffffffff0000;
	arg.size = 0x80000000; /*2 Gb*/
	arg.flags = 0x7;
	ret = drmIoctl(fd, 0xc1186451/*amdgpu_gem_userptr_ioctl*/, &arg);
}

Due to the address and size are not valid there is a failure in
amdgpu_hmm_register->mmu_interval_notifier_insert->__mmu_interval_notifier_insert->
check_shl_overflow, but we even the amdgpu_hmm_register failure we still call
amdgpu_hmm_unregister into  amdgpu_gem_object_free which causes access to a bad address.
The following stack is below when the issue is reproduced when Kazan is enabled:

RECORDS.description_main:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/sched: fix null-ptr-deref in init entity

The bug can be triggered by sending an amdgpu_cs_wait_ioctl
to the AMDGPU DRM driver on any ASICs with valid context.
The bug was reported by Joonkyo Jung <joonkyoj@yonsei.ac.kr>.
For example the following code:

    static void Syzkaller2(int fd)
    {
	union drm_amdgpu_ctx arg1;
	union drm_amdgpu_wait_cs arg2;

	arg1.in.op = AMDGPU_CTX_OP_ALLOC_CTX;
	ret = drmIoctl(fd, 0x140106442 /* amdgpu_ctx_ioctl */, &arg1);

	arg2.in.handle = 0x0;
	arg2.in.timeout = 0x2000000000000;
	arg2.in.ip_type = AMD_IP_VPE /* 0x9 */;
	arg2->in.ip_instance = 0x0;
	arg2.in.ring = 0x0;
	arg2.in.ctx_id = arg1.out.alloc.ctx_id;

	drmIoctl(fd, 0xc0206449 /* AMDGPU_WAIT_CS * /, &arg2);
    }

The ioctl AMDGPU_WAIT_CS without previously submitted job could be assumed that
the error should be returned, but the following commit 1decbf6bb0b4dc56c9da6c5e57b994ebfc2be3aa
modified the logic and allowed to have sched_rq equal to NULL.

As a result when there is no job the ioctl AMDGPU_WAIT_CS returns success.
The change fixes null-ptr-deref in init entity and the stack below demonstrates
the error condition:

RECORDS.description_main:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: cfg80211: detect stuck ECSA element in probe resp

We recently added some validation that we don't try to
connect to an AP that is currently in a channel switch
process, since that might want the channel to be quiet
or we might not be able to connect in time to hear the
switching in a beacon. This was in commit c09c4f31998b
("wifi: mac80211: don't connect to an AP while it's in
a CSA process").

However, we promptly got a report that this caused new
connection failures, and it turns out that the AP that
we now cannot connect to is permanently advertising an
extended channel switch announcement, even with quiet.
The AP in question was an Asus RT-AC53, with firmware
3.0.0.4.380_10760-g21a5898.

As a first step, attempt to detect that we're dealing
with such a situation, so mac80211 can use this later.

After tx is done, ionic_tx_clean() frees that page.
But RX ring buffer isn't reset to NULL.

RECORDS.description_main:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xdp: fix invalid wait context of page_pool_destroy()

If the driver uses a page pool, it creates a page pool with
page_pool_create().
The reference count of page pool is 1 as default.
A page pool will be destroyed only when a reference count reaches 0.
page_pool_destroy() is used to destroy page pool, it decreases a
reference count.
When a page pool is destroyed, ->disconnect() is called, which is
mem_allocator_disconnect().
This function internally acquires mutex_lock().

If the driver uses XDP, it registers a memory model with
xdp_rxq_info_reg_mem_model().
The xdp_rxq_info_reg_mem_model() internally increases a page pool
reference count if a memory model is a page pool.
Now the reference count is 2.

To destroy a page pool, the driver should call both page_pool_destroy()
and xdp_unreg_mem_model().
The xdp_unreg_mem_model() internally calls page_pool_destroy().
Only page_pool_destroy() decreases a reference count.

If a driver calls page_pool_destroy() then xdp_unreg_mem_model(), we
will face an invalid wait context warning.
Because xdp_unreg_mem_model() calls page_pool_destroy() with
rcu_read_lock().
The page_pool_destroy() internally acquires mutex_lock().

{"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xdp: fix invalid wait context of page_pool_destroy()

If the driver uses a page pool, it creates a page pool with
page_pool_create().
The reference count of page pool is 1 as default.
A page pool will be destroyed only when a reference count reaches 0.
page_pool_destroy() is used to destroy page pool, it decreases a
reference count.
When a page pool is destroyed, ->disconnect() is called, which is
mem_allocator_disconnect().
This function internally acquires mutex_lock().

If the driver uses XDP, it registers a memory model with
xdp_rxq_info_reg_mem_model().
The xdp_rxq_info_reg_mem_model() internally increases a page pool
reference count if a memory model is a page pool.
Now the reference count is 2.

To destroy a page pool, the driver should call both page_pool_destroy()
and xdp_unreg_mem_model().
The xdp_unreg_mem_model() internally calls page_pool_destroy().
Only page_pool_destroy() decreases a reference count.

If a driver calls page_pool_destroy() then xdp_unreg_mem_model(), we
will face an invalid wait context warning.
Because xdp_unreg_mem_model() calls page_pool_destroy() with
rcu_read_lock().
The page_pool_destroy() internally acquires mutex_lock().

RECORDS.description_main:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

afs: Fix lock recursion

afs_wake_up_async_call() can incur lock recursion.  The problem is that it
is called from AF_RXRPC whilst holding the ->notify_lock, but it tries to
take a ref on the afs_call struct in order to pass it to a work queue - but
if the afs_call is already queued, we then have an extraneous ref that must
be put... calling afs_put_call() may call back down into AF_RXRPC through
rxrpc_kernel_shutdown_call(), however, which might try taking the
->notify_lock again.

This case isn't very common, however, so defer it to a workqueue.  The oops
looks something like:

  BUG: spinlock recursion on CPU#0, krxrpcio/7001/1646
   lock: 0xffff888141399b30, .magic: dead4ead, .owner: krxrpcio/7001/1646, .owner_cpu: 0
  CPU: 0 UID: 0 PID: 1646 Comm: krxrpcio/7001 Not tainted 6.12.0-rc2-build3+ #4351
  Hardware name: ASUS All Series/H97-PLUS, BIOS 2306 10/09/2014
  Call Trace:
   <TASK>
   dump_stack_lvl+0x47/0x70
   do_raw_spin_lock+0x3c/0x90
   rxrpc_kernel_shutdown_call+0x83/0xb0
   afs_put_call+0xd7/0x180
   rxrpc_notify_socket+0xa0/0x190
   rxrpc_input_split_jumbo+0x198/0x1d0

   rxrpc_input_packet_on_conn+0x1e1/0x210
   rxrpc_input_packet+0x3f2/0x4d0
   rxrpc_io_thread+0x243/0x410
   ? __pfx_rxrpc_io_thread+0x10/0x10

VBIOS dmub is not active, since the PSP policy is to retain the driver
loaded version on subsequent warm boots. Hence, communication with VBIOS
DMUB fails.

RECORDS.solution: 请使用最新补丁程序修复此漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: ASUS VivoMini/Mini PC device has an improper input validation vulnerability. A local attacker with system privilege can use system management interrupt (SMI) to modify memory, resulting in arbitrary code execution for controlling the system or disrupting service.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 本地攻击者可利用系统管理中断 (SMI) 修改内存，导致任意代码执行，控制系统或干扰服务。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ASUS VivoMini/Mini PC device has an improper input validation vulnerability. A local attacker with system privilege can use system management interrupt (SMI) to modify memory, resulting in arbitrary code execution for controlling the system or disrupting service."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS RT-AX56U登录功能存在路径遍历漏洞
RECORDS.solution: ASUS已为此问题发布了固件更新。用户应该立即升级到最新版本，以确保系统的安全性。此外，应该避免使用弱密码和多个管理帐户，以最大程度地降低风险。
RECORDS.description_main: ASUS RT-AX56U’s login function contains a path traversal vulnerability due to its inadequate filtering for special characters in URL parameters, which allows an unauthenticated local area network attacker to access restricted system paths and download arbitrary files.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS RT-AX56U的登录功能包含路径遍历漏洞，由于URL参数中的特殊字符过滤不足，未经身份验证的本地区域网络攻击者可以访问受限系统路径并下载任意文件。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ASUS RT-AX56U’s login function contains a path traversal vulnerability due to its inadequate filtering for special characters in URL parameters, which allows an unauthenticated local area network attacker to access restricted system paths and download arbitrary files."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ROG Live Service存在文件删除漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 更新ROG Live Service以修复漏洞。同时，应该确保在执行文件操作之前验证路径，并限制权限以防止未经授权的文件访问。
RECORDS.description_main: ROG Live Service’s function for deleting temp files created by installation has an improper link resolution before file access vulnerability. Since this function does not validate the path before deletion, an unauthenticated local attacker can create an unexpected symbolic link to system file path, to delete arbitrary system files and disrupt system service.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ROG Live Service中的文件删除功能在文件访问之前有不正确的链接解决方式。由于此功能在删除之前不验证路径，未经身份验证的本地攻击者可以创建意外的符号链接到系统文件路径，删除任意系统文件并干扰系统服务。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ROG Live Service’s function for deleting temp files created by installation has an improper link resolution before file access vulnerability. Since this function does not validate the path before deletion, an unauthenticated local attacker can create an unexpected symbolic link to system file path, to delete arbitrary system files and disrupt system service."}]}

RECORDS.description_main: ASUS RT-AX56U’s update_json function has a path traversal vulnerability due to insufficient filtering for special characters in the URL parameter. An unauthenticated LAN attacker can overwrite a system file by uploading another file with the same file name, which results in service disruption.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 由于URL参数中特殊字符的过滤不足，ASUS RT-AX56U的update_json函数存在路径遍历漏洞。攻击者可以通过上传一个与系统文件同名的文件来覆盖目标文件，从而造成服务中断，而且攻击者无需进行认证即可实施此攻击。

An unauthenticated LAN attacker can overwrite a system file by uploading another file with the same file name, which results in service disruption."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS RT-AX56U 存在 SQL 注入漏洞
RECORDS.solution: ASUS 已经发布了修复程序。建议用户尽快更新固件版本以避免遭受攻击。同时，用户也可以通过设置强密码和禁用不必要的功能来提高设备安全性。

RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS RT-AC86U 的 LPD 服务在用户请求中没有足够的特殊字符过滤，使未认证的本地网络攻击者能够执行命令注入攻击，执行任意命令，以及干扰或终止服务。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ASUS RT-AC86U’s LPD service has insufficient filtering for special characters in the user request, which allows an unauthenticated LAN attacker to perform command injection attack, execute arbitrary commands and disrupt or terminate service."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Asuswrt和Asuswrt-Merlin New Gen存在内存破坏漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 更新Asuswrt和Asuswrt-Merlin New Gen至最新版本。
RECORDS.description_main: A memory corruption vulnerability exists in the httpd unescape functionality of Asuswrt prior to 3.0.0.4.386_48706 and Asuswrt-Merlin New Gen prior to 386.7.. A specially-crafted HTTP request can lead to memory corruption. An attacker can send a network request to trigger this vulnerability.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在Asuswrt 3.0.0.4.386_48706之前和Asuswrt-Merlin New Gen 386.7之前的unescape功能中存在内存破坏漏洞。恶意的HTTP请求可以导致内存破坏。攻击者可以发送网络请求来触发此漏洞。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A memory corruption vulnerability exists in the httpd unescape functionality of Asuswrt prior to 3.0.0.4.386_48706 and Asuswrt-Merlin New Gen prior to 386.7.. A specially-crafted HTTP request can lead to memory corruption. An attacker can send a network request to trigger this vulnerability."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS Control Center API存在破坏访问控制漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 升级到最新版本并应用厂商提供的安全补丁。同时确保网络安全设置得当并限制远程访问。
RECORDS.description_main: ASUS Control Center API has a broken access control vulnerability. An unauthenticated remote attacker can call privileged API functions to perform partial system operations or cause partial disrupt of service.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 未经身份验证的远程攻击者可以调用特权API函数来执行部分系统操作或导致部分服务中断。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ASUS Control Center API has a broken access control vulnerability. An unauthenticated remote attacker can call privileged API functions to perform partial system operations or cause partial disrupt of service."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS Control Center存在SQL注入漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 更新ASUS Control Center软件，确保使用最新版本。此外，开发人员应采取安全编码实践，如参数化查询和输入验证，以减少SQL注入攻击的风险。
RECORDS.description_main: ASUS Control Center is vulnerable to SQL injection. An authenticated remote attacker with general user privilege can inject SQL command to specific API parameters to acquire database schema or access data.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 未经身份验证的远程攻击者，拥有一般用户权限，可以向特定API参数注入SQL命令，从而获取数据库模式或访问数据。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ASUS Control Center is vulnerable to SQL injection. An authenticated remote attacker with general user privilege can inject SQL command to specific API parameters to acquire database schema or access data."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS WebStorage APP源代码存在硬编码的API令牌
RECORDS.solution: ASUS WebStorage需要尽快更新应用程序以避免令牌被硬编码到源代码中。此外，建议使用动态API令牌来增强应用程序的安全性。在登录相关时，建议启用多因素身份验证以进一步保障用户账户安全。
RECORDS.description_main: ASUS WebStorage has a hardcoded API Token in the APP source code. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use this token to establish connections with the server and carry out login attempts to general user accounts. A successful login to a general user account allows the attacker to access, modify or delete this user account information.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS WebStorage应用程序源代码中硬编码了API令牌。未经身份验证的远程攻击者可以使用此令牌与服务器建立连接，并尝试登录普通用户账户。成功登录普通用户账户允许攻击者访问、修改或删除该用户账户信息。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ASUS WebStorage has a hardcoded API Token in the APP source code. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use this token to establish connections with the server and carry out login attempts to general user accounts. A successful login to a general user account allows the attacker to access, modify or delete this user account information."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS RT-AX88U 的 HTTP 头参数不足以过滤特殊字符，攻击者可以利用这个漏洞插入 JavaScript 代码实施存储型跨站脚本攻击（XSS）。
RECORDS.solution: ASUS 发布了一个固件更新，为 RT-AX88U 解决了此漏洞。用户应立即升级固件以保护自己免受攻击。
RECORDS.description_main: ASUS RT-AX88U has insufficient filtering for special characters in the HTTP header parameter. A remote attacker with general user privilege can exploit this vulnerability to inject JavaScript and perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS RT-AX88U 存在安全漏洞，攻击者可以在 HTTP 头参数中插入特殊字符以执行存储型跨站脚本攻击。攻击者无需管理员权限，只需要一般用户权限即可利用此漏洞。攻击者可以通过 XSS 攻击窃取用户敏感信息、修改页面内容或执行其他恶意操作。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ASUS RT-AX88U has insufficient filtering for special characters in the HTTP header parameter. A remote attacker with general user privilege can exploit this vulnerability to inject JavaScript and perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS RT-AX88U存在格式化字符串漏洞
RECORDS.solution: ASUS官方已经发布了针对该漏洞的修复程序，请用户及时更新路由器的固件版本。
RECORDS.description_main: ASUS RT-AX88U has a Format String vulnerability, which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write to arbitrary memory address and perform remote arbitrary code execution, arbitrary system operation or disrupt service.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS RT-AX88U存在格式化字符串漏洞，允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者写入任意内存地址并执行远程任意代码、任意系统操作或破坏服务。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ASUS RT-AX88U has a Format String vulnerability, which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write to arbitrary memory address and perform remote arbitrary code execution, arbitrary system operation or disrupt service."}]}

RECORDS.description_main: AMI (aka American Megatrends) NTFS driver 1.0.0 (fixed in late 2021 or early 2022) has a buffer overflow. This driver is, for example, used in certain ASUS devices.
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"AMI (aka American Megatrends) NTFS driver 1.0.0 (fixed in late 2021 or early 2022) has a buffer overflow. This driver is, for example, used in certain ASUS devices."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS RT-N53 3.0.0.4.376.3754命令注入漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 升级至最新版本或者应用官方提供的修复补丁程序。同时建议管理员注意网络安全，限制设备访问权限，以防止未授权的访问。
RECORDS.description_main: ASUS RT-N53 3.0.0.4.376.3754 has a command injection vulnerability in the SystemCmd parameter of the apply.cgi interface.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS RT-N53 3.0.0.4.376.3754版本在apply.cgi接口的SystemCmd参数存在命令注入漏洞。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ASUS RT-N53 3.0.0.4.376.3754 has a command injection vulnerability in the SystemCmd parameter of the apply.cgi interface."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Asus RT-AX82U存在认证绕过漏洞
RECORDS.solution: Asus官方推出了固件更新，建议用户立即升级到最新版本以避免此漏洞的利用。
RECORDS.description_main: An authentication bypass vulnerability exists in the get_IFTTTTtoken.cgi functionality of Asus RT-AX82U 3.0.0.4.386_49674-ge182230. A specially-crafted HTTP request can lead to full administrative access to the device. An attacker would need to send a series of HTTP requests to exploit this vulnerability.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: Asus RT-AX82U 3.0.0.4.386_49674-ge182230 中的get_IFTTTTtoken.cgi 功能存在认证绕过漏洞。攻击者可以发送特制的HTTP请求，从而完全地访问设备的管理员权限。为利用此漏洞，攻击者需要发送一系列HTTP请求。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An authentication bypass vulnerability exists in the get_IFTTTTtoken.cgi functionality of Asus RT-AX82U 3.0.0.4.386_49674-ge182230. A specially-crafted HTTP request can lead to full administrative access to the device. An attacker would need to send a series of HTTP requests to exploit this vulnerability."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUSTeK Aura Ready Game SDK服务中存在未引用的服务路径漏洞 (GameSDK.exe) 1.0.0.4
RECORDS.solution: 升级ASUSTeK Aura Ready Game SDK服务的版本，或将恶意文件从% PROGRAMFILES（X86）% \ ASUS \ GameSDK.exe删除。
RECORDS.description_main: There is an unquoted service path in ASUSTeK Aura Ready Game SDK service (GameSDK.exe) 1.0.0.4. This might allow a local user to escalate privileges by creating a %PROGRAMFILES(X86)%\ASUS\GameSDK.exe file.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUSTeK Aura Ready Game SDK服务中存在未引用的服务路径漏洞，攻击者可以通过创建一个% PROGRAMFILES（X86）% \ ASUS \ GameSDK.exe文件，将本地用户权限提升。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"There is an unquoted service path in ASUSTeK Aura Ready Game SDK service (GameSDK.exe) 1.0.0.4. This might allow a local user to escalate privileges by creating a %PROGRAMFILES(X86)%\\ASUS\\GameSDK.exe file."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: AsusSwitch.exe 引起 ASUS 个人电脑（运行 Windows）的文件权限问题
RECORDS.solution: 升级 ASUS System Control Interface 3 至 3.1.5.0 或更高版本，升级 AsusSwitch.exe 至 1.0.10.0 或更高版本。
RECORDS.description_main: AsusSwitch.exe on ASUS personal computers (running Windows) sets weak file permissions, leading to local privilege escalation (this also can be used to delete files within the system arbitrarily). This affects ASUS System Control Interface 3 before 3.1.5.0, and AsusSwitch.exe before 1.0.10.0.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: AsusSwitch.exe 在 ASUS 个人电脑（运行 Windows）上设置了弱文件权限，导致本地权限提升漏洞（也可用于任意删除系统文件）。此漏洞影响 ASUS System Control Interface 3 版本小于 3.1.5.0 和 AsusSwitch.exe 版本小于 1.0.10.0。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"AsusSwitch.exe on ASUS personal computers (running Windows) sets weak file permissions, leading to local privilege escalation (this also can be used to delete files within the system arbitrarily). This affects ASUS System Control Interface 3 before 3.1.5.0, and AsusSwitch.exe before 1.0.10.0."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS个人电脑上的ASUS System Control Interface中的AsusSoftwareManager.exe允许本地用户通过SYSTEM特权将文件写入临时目录并删除另一个更为特权的文件
RECORDS.solution: 用户应当及时升级受影响的软件版本。ASUS已发布了更新版本，用户可前往官网下载并安装新版本，以确保系统安全。
RECORDS.description_main: AsusSoftwareManager.exe in ASUS System Control Interface on ASUS personal computers (running Windows) allows a local user to write into the Temp directory and delete another more privileged file via SYSTEM privileges. This affects ASUS System Control Interface 3 before 3.1.5.0, AsusSoftwareManger.exe before 1.0.53.0, and AsusLiveUpdate.dll before 1.0.45.0.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在运行Windows的ASUS个人电脑上，ASUS System Control Interface中的AsusSoftwareManager.exe允许本地用户通过SYSTEM特权将文件写入临时目录并删除另一个更为特权的文件。此漏洞影响ASUS System Control Interface 3版本3.1.5.0之前、AsusSoftwareManager.exe版本1.0.53.0之前以及AsusLiveUpdate.dll版本1.0.45.0之前。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"AsusSoftwareManager.exe in ASUS System Control Interface on ASUS personal computers (running Windows) allows a local user to write into the Temp directory and delete another more privileged file via SYSTEM privileges. This affects ASUS System Control Interface 3 before 3.1.5.0, AsusSoftwareManger.exe before 1.0.53.0, and AsusLiveUpdate.dll before 1.0.45.0."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ADM存在基于堆栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，当使用WebDAV时由于缺少数据大小验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞运行任意代码。受影响的ADM版本包括：3.5.9.RUE3及以下、4.0.5.RVI1及以下以及4.1.0.RJD1及以下。
RECORDS.solution: 更新 ADM 至最新版本，或使用其他安全措施保护系统免受攻击。
RECORDS.description_main: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability was found inside ADM when using WebDAV due to the lack of data size validation. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to run arbitrary code. Affected ADM versions include: 3.5.9.RUE3 and below, 4.0.5.RVI1 and below as well as 4.1.0.RJD1 and below.
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability was found inside ADM when using WebDAV due to the lack of data size validation. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to run arbitrary code. Affected ADM versions include: 3.5.9.RUE3 and below, 4.0.5.RVI1 and below as well as 4.1.0.RJD1 and below."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Asus RT-AX82U路由器配置服务中存在信息泄露漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 升级路由器固件版本或者关闭配置服务来避免此漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: An information disclosure vulnerability exists in the cm_processREQ_NC opcode of Asus RT-AX82U 3.0.0.4.386_49674-ge182230 router's configuration service. A specially-crafted network packets can lead to a disclosure of sensitive information. An attacker can send a network request to trigger this vulnerability.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: Asus RT-AX82U 3.0.0.4.386_49674-ge182230路由器的配置服务中存在cm_processREQ_NC操作码的信息泄露漏洞。恶意攻击者可以通过构造特定的网络数据包导致敏感信息的泄漏。攻击者可以发送一个网络请求来触发此漏洞。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An information disclosure vulnerability exists in the cm_processREQ_NC opcode of Asus RT-AX82U 3.0.0.4.386_49674-ge182230 router's configuration service. A specially-crafted network packets can lead to a disclosure of sensitive information. An attacker can send a network request to trigger this vulnerability."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Asus RT-AX82U路由器存在拒绝服务漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 目前没有公开的解决方案。建议升级到最新版本或关注厂商发布的安全补丁。
RECORDS.description_main: A denial of service vulnerability exists in the cfg_server cm_processConnDiagPktList opcode of Asus RT-AX82U 3.0.0.4.386_49674-ge182230 router's configuration service. A specially-crafted network packet can lead to denial of service. An attacker can send a malicious packet to trigger this vulnerability.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: Asus RT-AX82U 3.0.0.4.386_49674-ge182230路由器的配置服务中存在cfg_server cm_processConnDiagPktList的拒绝服务漏洞。特制的网络数据包可能会导致拒绝服务。攻击者可以发送恶意数据包触发此漏洞。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A denial of service vulnerability exists in the cfg_server cm_processConnDiagPktList opcode of Asus RT-AX82U 3.0.0.4.386_49674-ge182230 router's configuration service. A specially-crafted network packet can lead to denial of service. An attacker can send a malicious packet to trigger this vulnerability."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Armoury Crate Service日志功能缺乏足够验证，可能导致系统文件被覆盖
RECORDS.solution: 更新 Armoury Crate Service 至最新版本，或通过访问防病毒厂商或三方安全厂商的网站获取更多的更新信息。同时，使用具备有效防护机制的安全软件来防范该漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: Armoury Crate Service’s logging function has insufficient validation to check if the log file is a symbolic link. A physical attacker with general user privilege can modify the log file property to a symbolic link that points to arbitrary system file, causing the logging function to overwrite the system file and disrupt the system.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: Armoury Crate Service的日志功能缺乏足够验证，无法检查日志文件是否为符号链接。一位普通用户权限的物理攻击者可以修改日志文件属性为符号链接，并指向任意系统文件，从而使得日志功能覆盖该系统文件，并破坏系统。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Armoury Crate Service’s logging function has insufficient validation to check if the log file is a symbolic link. A physical attacker with general user privilege can modify the log file property to a symbolic link that points to arbitrary system file, causing the logging function to overwrite the system file and disrupt the system."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Asus NAS-M25存在'OS命令注入'漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可以通过未经过滤的Cookie值注入任意的OS命令。该问题影响NAS-M25: 至1.0.1.7版本。
RECORDS.solution: 由于该漏洞为代码缺陷所致，因此需要升级到最新版本。建议升级至NAS-M25 1.0.1.8版本或更高版本。此外，还应将输入过滤策略纳入到开发计划中，避免类似漏洞在未来再次出现。
RECORDS.description_main: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability in Asus NAS-M25 allows an unauthenticated attacker to inject arbitrary OS commands via unsanitized cookie values.This issue affects NAS-M25: through 1.0.1.7.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: Asus NAS-M25 存在 OS Command Injection (OS命令注入) 漏洞，攻击者可利用未经过滤的Cookie值注入任意的OS命令以实现攻击。该漏洞可被远程未经身份验证的攻击者利用。漏洞影响 NAS-M25 至1.0.1.7 版本。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability in Asus NAS-M25 allows an unauthenticated attacker to inject arbitrary OS commands via unsanitized cookie values.This issue affects NAS-M25: through 1.0.1.7.\n\n"}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS EC Tool driver 存在本地提权漏洞
RECORDS.solution: ASUS已更新了相关驱动程序并推出了修复方案，请及时更新。
RECORDS.description_main: ASUS EC Tool driver (aka d.sys) 1beb15c90dcf7a5234ed077833a0a3e900969b60be1d04fcebce0a9f8994bdbb, as signed by ASUS and shipped with multiple ASUS software products, contains multiple IOCTL handlers that provide raw read and write access to port I/O and MSRs via unprivileged IOCTL calls. Local users can gain privileges.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS EC Tool driver (也称为d.sys) 1beb15c90dcf7a5234ed077833a0a3e900969b60be1d04fcebce0a9f8994bdbb，由ASUS签名并随多个ASUS软件产品一起发布，其中包含多个IOCTL处理程序，通过非特权IOCTL调用提供原始读取和写入访问权限到端口I / O和MSR。本地用户可以获得权限。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ASUS EC Tool driver (aka d.sys) 1beb15c90dcf7a5234ed077833a0a3e900969b60be1d04fcebce0a9f8994bdbb, as signed by ASUS and shipped with multiple ASUS software products, contains multiple IOCTL handlers that provide raw read and write access to port I/O and MSRs via unprivileged IOCTL calls. Local users can gain privileges."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Asus Aura Sync 存在漏洞导致 DoS 攻击和提权
RECORDS.solution: 更新至最新版本的 Asus Aura Sync，以修复该漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: The MsIo64.sys component in Asus Aura Sync through v1.07.79 does not properly validate input to IOCTL 0x80102040, 0x80102044, 0x80102050, and 0x80102054, allowing attackers to trigger a memory corruption and cause a Denial of Service (DoS) or escalate privileges via crafted IOCTL requests.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 通过 Asus Aura Sync v1.07.79 版本的 MsIo64.sys 组件，没有正确验证 IOCTL 0x80102040、0x80102044、0x80102050 和 0x80102054 输入，使攻击者可以通过特制的 IOCTL 请求触发内存损坏并导致拒绝服务（DoS）或提升特权。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The MsIo64.sys component in Asus Aura Sync through v1.07.79 does not properly validate input to IOCTL 0x80102040, 0x80102044, 0x80102050, and 0x80102054, allowing attackers to trigger a memory corruption and cause a Denial of Service (DoS) or escalate privileges via crafted IOCTL requests."}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ALSA: emu10k1: Fix out of bounds access in snd_emu10k1_pcm_channel_alloc()

The voice allocator sometimes begins allocating from near the end of the
array and then wraps around, however snd_emu10k1_pcm_channel_alloc()
accesses the newly allocated voices as if it never wrapped around.

This results in out of bounds access if the first voice has a high enough
index so that first_voice + requested_voice_count > NUM_G (64).
The more voices are requested, the more likely it is for this to occur.

This was initially discovered using PipeWire, however it can be reproduced
by calling aplay multiple times with 16 channels:
aplay -r 48000 -D plughw:CARD=Live,DEV=3 -c 16 /dev/zero

UBSAN: array-index-out-of-bounds in sound/pci/emu10k1/emupcm.c:127:40
index 65 is out of range for type 'snd_emu10k1_voice [64]'
CPU: 1 PID: 31977 Comm: aplay Tainted: G        W IOE      6.0.0-rc2-emu10k1+ #7
Hardware name: ASUSTEK COMPUTER INC P5W DH Deluxe/P5W DH Deluxe, BIOS 3002    07/22/2010
Call Trace:
<TASK>
dump_stack_lvl+0x49/0x63
dump_stack+0x10/0x16
ubsan_epilogue+0x9/0x3f
__ubsan_handle_out_of_bounds.cold+0x44/0x49

snd_pcm_hw_params+0x29f/0x600 [snd_pcm]

? exit_to_user_mode_prepare+0x35/0x170
? do_syscall_64+0x69/0x90
? syscall_exit_to_user_mode+0x26/0x50
? do_syscall_64+0x69/0x90

? do_syscall_64+0x69/0x90
? do_syscall_64+0x69/0x90
entry_SYSCALL_64_after_hwframe+0x63/0xcd

RECORDS.description_main:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

hwmon: (asus-ec-sensors) Add checks for devm_kcalloc

As the devm_kcalloc may return NULL, the return value needs to be checked
to avoid NULL poineter dereference.

to avoid NULL poineter dereference."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS笔记本上的UX360CA BIOS版本303及以前存在安全漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 请更新ASUS笔记本上的UX360CA BIOS至最新版本，以修复此漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: The UX360CA BIOS through 303 on ASUS laptops allow an attacker (with the ring 0 privilege) to overwrite nearly arbitrary physical memory locations, including SMRAM, and execute arbitrary code in the SMM (issue 3 of 3).
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS笔记本上的UX360CA BIOS版本303及以前存在安全漏洞，允许攻击者（拥有ring 0特权）覆盖几乎任意物理内存位置，包括SMRAM，并在SMM中执行任意代码（第3个问题）。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The UX360CA BIOS through 303 on ASUS laptops allow an attacker (with the ring 0 privilege) to overwrite nearly arbitrary physical memory locations, including SMRAM, and execute arbitrary code in the SMM (issue 3 of 3)."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Askey RTF8115VW BR_SV_g11.11_RTF_TEF001_V6.54_V014 设备允许 cgi-bin/te_acceso_router.cgi curWebPage 跨站脚本攻击
RECORDS.solution: 建议更新设备的固件版本或禁用或限制cgi-bin/te_acceso_router.cgi的访问权限。
RECORDS.description_main: Askey RTF8115VW BR_SV_g11.11_RTF_TEF001_V6.54_V014 devices allow cgi-bin/te_acceso_router.cgi curWebPage XSS.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 本漏洞允许攻击者通过向 cgi-bin/te_acceso_router.cgi 的 curWebPage 参数传递恶意代码来执行跨站脚本攻击。这可能导致受攻击的用户受到欺骗、信息泄露或其他攻击。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Askey RTF8115VW BR_SV_g11.11_RTF_TEF001_V6.54_V014 devices allow cgi-bin/te_acceso_router.cgi curWebPage XSS."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Askey RTF8115VW BR_SV_g11.11_RTF_TEF001_V6.54_V014设备允许注入Host HTTP头文件。
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已经发布了修复程序，建议及时升级到最新版本来修复漏洞。同时，建议关闭不必要的服务和功能，严格控制网络访问，保证网络安全。
RECORDS.description_main: Askey RTF8115VW BR_SV_g11.11_RTF_TEF001_V6.54_V014 devices allow injection of a Host HTTP header.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: Askey RTF8115VW BR_SV_g11.11_RTF_TEF001_V6.54_V014设备存在Host HTTP头部注入漏洞，攻击者可以利用该漏洞在HTTP请求中注入恶意内容，从而导致安全风险。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Askey RTF8115VW BR_SV_g11.11_RTF_TEF001_V6.54_V014 devices allow injection of a Host HTTP header."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS BMC 固件 Web 管理页面中的 Radius 配置功能存在缓冲区溢出漏洞
RECORDS.solution: ASUS 建议用户升级 BMC 固件，并避免向未经身份验证的用户公开 Web 界面。
RECORDS.description_main: The Radius configuration function in ASUS BMC’s firmware Web management page does not verify the string length entered by users, resulting in a Buffer overflow vulnerability. As obtaining the privileged permission, remote attackers use the leakage to abnormally terminate the Web service.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS BMC 固件 Web 管理页面中的 Radius 配置功能没有验证用户输入的字符串长度，导致缓冲区溢出漏洞。远程攻击者可以利用此漏洞获取特权权限，并使用泄漏信息异常终止 Web 服务。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The Radius configuration function in ASUS BMC’s firmware Web management page does not verify the string length entered by users, resulting in a Buffer overflow vulnerability. As obtaining the privileged permission, remote attackers use the leakage to abnormally terminate the Web service."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS GPUTweak II低权限用户NT SYSTEM特权提升漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 升级ASUS GPUTweak II到2.3.0.3之后的版本。
RECORDS.description_main: AsIO2_64.sys and AsIO2_32.sys in ASUS GPUTweak II before 2.3.0.3 allow low-privileged users to interact directly with physical memory (by calling one of several driver routines that map physical memory into the virtual address space of the calling process) and to interact with MSR registers. This could enable low-privileged users to achieve NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM privileges via a DeviceIoControl.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS GPUTweak II在2.3.0.3之前的版本中的AsIO2_64.sys和AsIO2_32.sys允许低权限用户直接与物理内存进行交互(通过调用一些驱动程序例程，将物理内存映射到调用进程的虚拟地址空间中)，并与MSR寄存器进行交互。这可能使低权限用户通过DeviceIoControl达到NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM特权。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"AsIO2_64.sys and AsIO2_32.sys in ASUS GPUTweak II before 2.3.0.3 allow low-privileged users to interact directly with physical memory (by calling one of several driver routines that map physical memory into the virtual address space of the calling process) and to interact with MSR registers. This could enable low-privileged users to achieve NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM privileges via a DeviceIoControl."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS路由器IPv6路由环路漏洞
RECORDS.description_main: In ASUS RT-AX3000, ZenWiFi AX (XT8), RT-AX88U, and other ASUS routers with firmware < 3.0.0.4.386.42095 or < 9.0.0.4.386.41994, when IPv6 is used, a routing loop can occur that generates excessive network traffic between an affected device and its upstream ISP's router. This occurs when a link prefix route points to a point-to-point link, a destination IPv6 address belongs to the prefix and is not a local IPv6 address, and a router advertisement is received with at least one global unique IPv6 prefix for which the on-link flag is set.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在ASUS RT-AX3000、ZenWiFi AX (XT8)、RT-AX88U等使用固件版本<3.0.0.4.386.42095或<9.0.0.4.386.41994的ASUS路由器中，当使用IPv6时，可能会发生路由环路，导致受影响设备和上游ISP路由器之间产生过多的网络流量。这是因为一个链路前缀路由指向一个点对点链路、目标IPv6地址属于该前缀且不是本地IPv6地址，同时接收到至少一个全局唯一IPv6前缀的路由广告被设置为on-link标记。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"In ASUS RT-AX3000, ZenWiFi AX (XT8), RT-AX88U, and other ASUS routers with firmware \u003c 3.0.0.4.386.42095 or \u003c 9.0.0.4.386.41994, when IPv6 is used, a routing loop can occur that generates excessive network traffic between an affected device and its upstream ISP's router. This occurs when a link prefix route points to a point-to-point link, a destination IPv6 address belongs to the prefix and is not a local IPv6 address, and a router advertisement is received with at least one global unique IPv6 prefix for which the on-link flag is set."}]}

RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An issue was discovered on ASUS DSL-N14U-B1 1.1.2.3_805 devices. An attacker can upload arbitrary file content as a firmware update when the filename Settings_DSL-N14U-B1.trx is used. Once this file is loaded, shutdown measures on a wide range of services are triggered as if it were a real update, resulting in a persistent outage of those services."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS GT-AC2900设备在3.0.0.4.386.42643之前的管理员应用程序存在身份验证绕过漏洞
RECORDS.solution: ASUS于2021年7月6日发布了软件更新，修复了此漏洞。建议受影响的用户立即更新他们的设备到最新版本，以避免任何安全风险。
RECORDS.description_main: The administrator application on ASUS GT-AC2900 devices before 3.0.0.4.386.42643 and Lyra Mini before 3.0.0.4_384_46630 allows authentication bypass when processing remote input from an unauthenticated user, leading to unauthorized access to the administrator interface. This relates to handle_request in router/httpd/httpd.c and auth_check in web_hook.o. An attacker-supplied value of '\0' matches the device's default value of '\0' in some situations. Note: All versions of Lyra Mini and earlier which are unsupported (End-of-Life, EOL) are also affected by this vulnerability, Consumers can mitigate this vulnerability by disabling the remote access features from WAN.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS GT-AC2900设备在3.0.0.4.386.42643之前的管理员应用程序在处理未经身份验证用户的远程输入时存在身份验证绕过漏洞，导致未经授权访问管理员界面。与路由器/ httpd / httpd.c中的handle_request和web_hook.o中的auth_check相关。在某些情况下，攻击者提供的 "\0" 值与设备的默认值 "\ 0" 匹配。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The administrator application on ASUS GT-AC2900 devices before 3.0.0.4.386.42643 and Lyra Mini before 3.0.0.4_384_46630 allows authentication bypass when processing remote input from an unauthenticated user, leading to unauthorized access to the administrator interface. This relates to handle_request in router/httpd/httpd.c and auth_check in web_hook.o. An attacker-supplied value of '\\0' matches the device's default value of '\\0' in some situations. Note: All versions of Lyra Mini and earlier which are unsupported (End-of-Life, EOL) are also affected by this vulnerability, Consumers can mitigate this vulnerability by disabling the remote access features from WAN."}]}

RECORDS.solution: 建议用户立即下载并安装最新版本的ASUS RT-AC68U路由器固件，以修复该漏洞。此外，用户还可以采取其他安全措施，例如禁用Cloud Disk功能或使用防火墙等措施限制外部访问。
RECORDS.description_main: SQL injection vulnerability in Cloud Disk in ASUS RT-AC68U router firmware version before 3.0.0.4.386.41634 allows remote attackers to view sensitive information via /etc/shadow.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS RT-AC68U路由器固件版本3.0.0.4.386.41634之前的Cloud Disk存在SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可以通过该漏洞远程查看敏感信息。具体地，攻击者可以通过注入恶意SQL代码来进一步查询系统文件/etc/shadow中的敏感数据。这种漏洞可能导致身份盗窃和账户接管等安全问题。建议用户立即升级到最新版本的固件或采取其他安全措施。

RECORDS.solution: ASUS已发布包含该修复程序的APAC 3.0.0.4.386.41994版本固件。请及时更新您的固件以免遭受攻击。
RECORDS.description_main: Directory Traversal vulnerability in Cloud Disk in ASUS RT-AC68U router firmware version before 3.0.0.4.386.41634 allows remote attackers to write arbitrary files via improper sanitation on the target for COPY and MOVE operations.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许攻击者通过目标不当清理实施COPY和MOVE操作，在远程写入任意文件。由于存在目录遍历漏洞，攻击者可以进入服务器根目录并执行攻击。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Directory Traversal vulnerability in Cloud Disk in ASUS RT-AC68U router firmware version before 3.0.0.4.386.41634 allows remote attackers to write arbitrary files via improper sanitation on the target for COPY and MOVE operations."}]}

RECORDS.solution: ASUS 已发布固件更新，修复了该漏洞。建议用户及时更新路由器固件，以提高设备安全性。同时，也建议用户设置强密码，并开启路由器的防火墙功能，以增强网络安全防护能力。
RECORDS.description_main: ASUS routers Wi-Fi protected access protocol (WPA2 and WPA3-SAE) has improper control of Interaction frequency vulnerability, an unauthenticated attacker can remotely disconnect other users' connections by sending specially crafted SAE authentication frames.

RECORDS.solution: ASUS推出了固件版本3.0.0.4.386.44452，修复了该漏洞，建议用户及时更新该固件版本以保护自己的设备安全。

RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A stack overflow vulnerability exists in the httpd service in ASUS RT-AX56U Router Version 3.0.0.4.386.44266. This vulnerability is caused by the strcat function called by \"caupload\" input handle function allowing the user to enter 0xFFFF bytes into the stack. This vulnerability allows an attacker to execute commands remotely. The vulnerability requires authentication."}]}

RECORDS.solution: ASUS 建议用户尽快更新最新版 BIOS，以修复此漏洞。此外，建议用户不要在不受信任的环境下使用该设备，以避免遭受攻击。

RECORDS.description_main:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: x86: Ensure liveliness of nested VM-Enter fail tracepoint message

Use the __string() machinery provided by the tracing subystem to make a
copy of the string literals consumed by the "nested VM-Enter failed"
tracepoint.  A complete copy is necessary to ensure that the tracepoint
can't outlive the data/memory it consumes and deference stale memory.

Because the tracepoint itself is defined by kvm, if kvm-intel and/or
kvm-amd are built as modules, the memory holding the string literals
defined by the vendor modules will be freed when the module is unloaded,
whereas the tracepoint and its data in the ring buffer will live until
kvm is unloaded (or "indefinitely" if kvm is built-in).

This bug has existed since the tracepoint was added, but was recently
exposed by a new check in tracing to detect exactly this type of bug.

  fmt: '%s%s
  ' current_buffer: ' vmx_dirty_log_t-140127  [003] ....  kvm_nested_vmenter_failed: '
  WARNING: CPU: 3 PID: 140134 at kernel/trace/trace.c:3759 trace_check_vprintf+0x3be/0x3e0
  CPU: 3 PID: 140134 Comm: less Not tainted 5.13.0-rc1-ce2e73ce600a-req #184
  Hardware name: ASUS Q87M-E/Q87M-E, BIOS 1102 03/03/2014
  RIP: 0010:trace_check_vprintf+0x3be/0x3e0
  Code: <0f> 0b 44 8b 4c 24 1c e9 a9 fe ff ff c6 44 02 ff 00 49 8b 97 b0 20
  RSP: 0018:ffffa895cc37bcb0 EFLAGS: 00010282
  RAX: 0000000000000000 RBX: ffffa895cc37bd08 RCX: 0000000000000027
  RDX: 0000000000000027 RSI: 00000000ffffdfff RDI: ffff9766cfad74f8
  RBP: ffffffffc0a041d4 R08: ffff9766cfad74f0 R09: ffffa895cc37bad8
  R10: 0000000000000001 R11: 0000000000000001 R12: ffffffffc0a041d4
  R13: ffffffffc0f4dba8 R14: 0000000000000000 R15: ffff976409f2c000
  FS:  00007f92fa200740(0000) GS:ffff9766cfac0000(0000) knlGS:0000000000000000
  CS:  0010 DS: 0000 ES: 0000 CR0: 0000000080050033

   trace_event_printf+0x5e/0x80

kvm is unloaded (or "indefinitely" if kvm is built-in).

This bug has existed since the tracepoint was added, but was recently
exposed by a new check in tracing to detect exactly this type of bug.

RECORDS.title_zh: The Open Connectivity Foundation UPnP specification before 2020-04-17 does not forbid the acceptance of a subscription request with a delivery URL on a different network segment than the fully qualified event-subscription URL, aka the CallStranger issue.
RECORDS.solution: 更新UPnP规范以禁止接受发送到不同网络段的投递URL的订阅请求。
RECORDS.description_main: The Open Connectivity Foundation UPnP specification before 2020-04-17 does not forbid the acceptance of a subscription request with a delivery URL on a different network segment than the fully qualified event-subscription URL, aka the CallStranger issue.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在2020年4月17日之前，开放互联互通基金会UPnP规范未禁止接受发送到不同网络段的投递URL的订阅请求，而完全合格的事件订阅URL，也就是CallStranger问题。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The Open Connectivity Foundation UPnP specification before 2020-04-17 does not forbid the acceptance of a subscription request with a delivery URL on a different network segment than the fully qualified event-subscription URL, aka the CallStranger issue."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: AsusScreenXpertServicec.exe 和 ScreenXpertUpgradeServiceManager.exe 的漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 我们建议用户立即更新他们的 ASUS PC 上的 ScreenPad2_Upgrade_Tool.msi 到最新版本以修复此漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: AsusScreenXpertServicec.exe and ScreenXpertUpgradeServiceManager.exe in ScreenPad2_Upgrade_Tool.msi V1.0.3 for ASUS PCs with ScreenPad 1.0 (UX450FDX, UX550GDX and UX550GEX) could lead to unsigned code execution with no additional restrictions when a user puts an application at a particular path with a particular file name.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 针对拥有 ScreenPad 1.0（UX450FDX、UX550GDX 和 UX550GEX）的 ASUS 电脑上的 ScreenPad2_Upgrade_Tool.msi V1.0.3 中的 AsusScreenXpertServicec.exe 和 ScreenXpertUpgradeServiceManager.exe 存在漏洞，如果用户将应用程序放在特定路径并给定特定文件名，可能会导致未签名代码执行而没有其他限制。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"AsusScreenXpertServicec.exe and ScreenXpertUpgradeServiceManager.exe in ScreenPad2_Upgrade_Tool.msi V1.0.3 for ASUS PCs with ScreenPad 1.0 (UX450FDX, UX550GDX and UX550GEX) could lead to unsigned code execution with no additional restrictions when a user puts an application at a particular path with a particular file name."}]}

RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS RT-AC1900P 路由器在版本 3.0.0.4.385_20253 之前存在漏洞，允许使用任意服务器证书进行固件更新。此漏洞是由于 wget 工具中的 --no-check-certificate 选项导致下载固件更新文件时存在风险。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An issue was discovered on ASUS RT-AC1900P routers before 3.0.0.4.385_20253. The router accepts an arbitrary server certificate for a firmware update. The culprit is the --no-check-certificate option passed to wget tool used to download firmware update files."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Asus RT-N12E存在访问控制漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 升级到最新版本以修复该漏洞。

RECORDS.description_main_zh: Asus RT-N12E 2.0.0.39存在一个访问控制漏洞。攻击者可以利用system.asp/start_apply.htm来更改管理员密码而无需进行任何身份验证。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Asus RT-N12E 2.0.0.39 is affected by an incorrect access control vulnerability. Through system.asp / start_apply.htm, an attacker can change the administrator password without any authentication."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: RT-AC88U Download Master参数注入漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 升级RT-AC88U Download Master至3.1.0.108版本或更高版本。
RECORDS.description_main: An injection vulnerability exists in RT-AC88U Download Master before 3.1.0.108. Accessing Main_Login.asp?flag=1&productname=FOOBAR&url=/downloadmaster/task.asp will redirect to the login site, which will show the value of the parameter productname within the title. An attacker might be able to influence the appearance of the login page, aka text injection.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在RT-AC88U Download Master 3.1.0.108版本之前存在注入漏洞。访问Main_Login.asp?flag=1&productname=FOOBAR&url=/downloadmaster/task.asp将重定向到登录站点，该站点将在标题中显示参数productname的值。攻击者可能能够影响登录页面的外观，也就是文本注入。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An injection vulnerability exists in RT-AC88U Download Master before 3.1.0.108. Accessing Main_Login.asp?flag=1\u0026productname=FOOBAR\u0026url=/downloadmaster/task.asp will redirect to the login site, which will show the value of the parameter productname within the title. An attacker might be able to influence the appearance of the login page, aka text injection."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: RT-AC88U Download Master存在信息泄露漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 建议升级到 RT-AC88U Download Master 3.1.0.108 及以上的版本，避免受到该漏洞的影响。
RECORDS.description_main: An information disclosure vulnerability exists in RT-AC88U Download Master before 3.1.0.108. A direct access to /downloadmaster/dm_apply.cgi?action_mode=initial&download_type=General&special_cgi=get_language makes it possible to reach "unknown functionality" in a "known to be easy" manner via an unspecified "public exploit."
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在 RT-AC88U Download Master 3.1.0.108 版本之前存在信息泄露漏洞。通过直接访问 /downloadmaster/dm_apply.cgi?action_mode=initial&download_type=General&special_cgi=get_language，可以使用未公开的“公共漏洞”以“已知易于”的方式达到“未知功能”。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An information disclosure vulnerability exists in RT-AC88U Download Master before 3.1.0.108. A direct access to /downloadmaster/dm_apply.cgi?action_mode=initial\u0026download_type=General\u0026special_cgi=get_language makes it possible to reach \"unknown functionality\" in a \"known to be easy\" manner via an unspecified \"public exploit.\""}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS DSL-N17U 固件 1.1.0.2 存在安全漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 升级到最新版本的固件或使用复杂的密码来保护管理员账户。同时，应使用其他安全措施，如网络隔离和入侵检测系统来增强安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: The ASUS DSL-N17U modem with firmware 1.1.0.2 allows attackers to access the admin interface by changing the admin password without authentication via a POST request to Advanced_System_Content.asp with the uiViewTools_username=admin&uiViewTools_Password= and uiViewTools_PasswordConfirm= substrings.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: ASUS DSL-N17U 固件 1.1.0.2 存在安全漏洞，攻击者可以通过向 Advanced_System_Content.asp 提交 POST 请求，并更改管理密码，绕过身份验证来访问管理界面。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The ASUS DSL-N17U modem with firmware 1.1.0.2 allows attackers to access the admin interface by changing the admin password without authentication via a POST request to Advanced_System_Content.asp with the uiViewTools_username=admin\u0026uiViewTools_Password= and uiViewTools_PasswordConfirm= substrings."}]}

RECORDS.solution: ASUS已发布修复版本9.0.0.4_386_40018，建议用户及时更新。

RECORDS.solution: ASUS已经发布了一个新的固件版本3.0.0.4.374.5517来修复这个漏洞。用户应该立即升级到该版本并避免使用任何可疑的客户端名称。

RECORDS.title_zh: Linux内核存在漏洞，通过触发asus_kbd_backlight_set中的用后释放可导致内存损坏
RECORDS.solution: 建议升级相关软件，以修复这个漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: A flaw was found in the Linux kernel. A use-after-free may be triggered in asus_kbd_backlight_set when plugging/disconnecting in a malicious USB device, which advertises itself as an Asus device. Similarly to the previous known CVE-2023-25012, but in asus devices, the work_struct may be scheduled by the LED controller while the device is disconnecting, triggering a use-after-free on the struct asus_kbd_leds *led structure. A malicious USB device may exploit the issue to cause memory corruption with controlled data.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在Linux内核中发现了一个漏洞，如果插入/拔出作为Asus设备广告的恶意USB设备，可能会触发asus_kbd_backlight_set中的用后释放。 与先前已知的CVE-2023-25012类似，但针对的是asus 设备，当设备断开连接时，LED控制器可能会安排work_struct，从而在struct asus_kbd_leds *led结构上触发用后释放。 恶意USB设备可以利用这个问题来使用受控数据引起内存损坏。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A flaw was found in the Linux kernel. A use-after-free may be triggered in asus_kbd_backlight_set when plugging/disconnecting in a malicious USB device, which advertises itself as an Asus device. Similarly to the previous known CVE-2023-25012, but in asus devices, the work_struct may be scheduled by the LED controller while the device is disconnecting, triggering a use-after-free on the struct asus_kbd_leds *led structure. A malicious USB device may exploit the issue to cause memory corruption with controlled data."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: 在ADM、LooksGood和SoundsGood应用程序上发现跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞
RECORDS.description_main: A Cross-Site Scripting(XSS) vulnerability was found on ADM, LooksGood and SoundsGood Apps. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to inject malicious scripts into the target applications to access any cookies or sensitive information retained by the browser and used with that application. Affected products and versions include: ADM 4.0.6.REG2, 4.1.0 and below as well as ADM 4.2.1.RGE2 and below, LooksGood 2.0.0.R129 and below and SoundsGood 2.3.0.r1027 and below.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在ADM、LooksGood和SoundsGood应用程序上发现了一个跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞。攻击者可以利用这个漏洞向目标应用程序注入恶意脚本，以获取浏览器保留的任何cookies或敏感信息，并用于该应用程序。受影响的产品和版本包括：ADM 4.0.6.REG2、4.1.0及以下版本，以及ADM 4.2.1.RGE2及以下版本，LooksGood 2.0.0.R129及以下版本，以及SoundsGood 2.3.0.r1027及以下版本。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A Cross-Site Scripting(XSS) vulnerability was found on ADM, LooksGood and SoundsGood Apps. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to inject malicious scripts into the target applications to access any cookies or sensitive information retained by the browser and used with that application. Affected products and versions include: ADM 4.0.6.REG2, 4.1.0 and below as well as ADM 4.2.1.RGE2 and below, LooksGood 2.0.0.R129 and below and SoundsGood 2.3.0.r1027 and below."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: DataHub开源元数据平台JAAS身份验证漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 用户需要升级版本以解决此漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: DataHub is an open-source metadata platform. In the event a system is using Java Authentication and Authorization Service (JAAS) authentication and that system is given a configuration which contains an error, the authentication for the system will fail open and allow an attacker to login using any username and password. The reason for this is that while an error is thrown in the `authenticateJaasUser` method it is swallowed without propagating the error. As a result of this issue unauthenticated users may gain access to the system. Users are advised to upgrade. There are no known workarounds for this issue. This vulnerability was discovered and reported by the GitHub Security lab and is tracked as GHSL-2022-081.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 如果系统使用Java身份验证和授权服务（JAAS）身份验证并且该系统给定的配置包含错误，则系统的身份验证将以失败开放的方式发生，从而允许攻击者使用任何用户名和密码进行登录。造成此问题的原因是在authenticateJaasUser方法中发生错误时，该错误被吞没而不会传播。由于这个问题，未经身份验证的用户可能会获得访问系统的权限。我们建议用户升级版本以解决此漏洞，目前没有已知的解决方法。该漏洞由GitHub安全实验室发现并报告，编号为GHSL-2022-081。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"DataHub is an open-source metadata platform. In the event a system is using Java Authentication and Authorization Service (JAAS) authentication and that system is given a configuration which contains an error, the authentication for the system will fail open and allow an attacker to login using any username and password. The reason for this is that while an error is thrown in the `authenticateJaasUser` method it is swallowed without propagating the error. As a result of this issue unauthenticated users may gain access to the system. Users are advised to upgrade. There are no known workarounds for this issue. This vulnerability was discovered and reported by the GitHub Security lab and is tracked as GHSL-2022-081."}]}

RECORDS.description_main: An information disclosure vulnerability exists in curl <v8.1.0 when doing HTTP(S) transfers, libcurl might erroneously use the read callback (`CURLOPT_READFUNCTION`) to ask for data to send, even when the `CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS` option has been set, if the same handle previously wasused to issue a `PUT` request which used that callback. This flaw may surprise the application and cause it to misbehave and either send off the wrong data or use memory after free or similar in the second transfer. The problem exists in the logic for a reused handle when it is (expected to be) changed from a PUT to a POST.
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An information disclosure vulnerability exists in curl \u003cv8.1.0 when doing HTTP(S) transfers, libcurl might erroneously use the read callback (`CURLOPT_READFUNCTION`) to ask for data to send, even when the `CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS` option has been set, if the same handle previously wasused to issue a `PUT` request which used that callback. This flaw may surprise the application and cause it to misbehave and either send off the wrong data or use memory after free or similar in the second transfer. The problem exists in the logic for a reused handle when it is (expected to be) changed from a PUT to a POST."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: ASUS RT-AX56U V2和RT-AC86U中的格式字符串漏洞
RECORDS.description_main:
It is identified a format string vulnerability in ASUS RT-AX56U V2 & RT-AC86U. This vulnerability is caused by directly using input as a format string when calling syslog in logmessage_normal function, in the do_detwan_cgi module of httpd. A remote attacker with administrator privilege can exploit this vulnerability to perform remote arbitrary code execution, arbitrary system operation or disrupt service.

This issue affects RT-AX56U V2: 3.0.0.4.386_50460; RT-AC86U: 3.0.0.4_386_51529.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在ASUS RT-AX56U V2和RT-AC86U中，存在一个格式字符串漏洞。该漏洞是由于在httpd的do_detwan_cgi模块中的logmessage_normal函数中调用syslog时，直接将输入作为格式字符串使用。未经身份验证的远程攻击者无需特权即可利用此漏洞执行远程任意代码执行、任意系统操作或中断服务。
RECORDS.descriptions:
{"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"
It is identified a format string vulnerability in ASUS RT-AX56U V2 & RT-AC86U. This vulnerability is caused by directly using input as a format string when calling syslog in logmessage_normal function, in the do_detwan_cgi module of httpd. A remote attacker with administrator privilege can exploit this vulnerability to perform remote arbitrary code execution, arbitrary system operation or disrupt service.

This issue affects RT-AX56U V2: 3.0.0.4.386_50460; RT-AC86U: 3.0.0.4_386_51529.

"}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
ASUS RT-AX92U lighttpd mod_webdav.so SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected ASUS RT-AX92U routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. 

The specific flaw exists within the mod_webdav.so module. When parsing a request, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-16078.
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"ASUS RT-AX92U lighttpd mod_webdav.so SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected ASUS RT-AX92U routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. \n\nThe specific flaw exists within the mod_webdav.so module. When parsing a request, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-16078."}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

rxrpc, afs: Fix peer hash locking vs RCU callback

In its address list, afs now retains pointers to and refs on one or more
rxrpc_peer objects.  The address list is freed under RCU and at this time,
it puts the refs on those peers.

Now, when an rxrpc_peer object runs out of refs, it gets removed from the
peer hash table and, for that, rxrpc has to take a spinlock.  However, it
is now being called from afs's RCU cleanup, which takes place in BH
context - but it is just taking an ordinary spinlock.

The put may also be called from non-BH context, and so there exists the
possibility of deadlock if the BH-based RCU cleanup happens whilst the hash
spinlock is held.  This led to the attached lockdep complaint.

Fix this by changing spinlocks of rxnet->peer_hash_lock back to
BH-disabling locks.

    ================================
    WARNING: inconsistent lock state
    6.13.0-rc5-build2+ #1223 Tainted: G            E
    --------------------------------
    inconsistent {SOFTIRQ-ON-W} -> {IN-SOFTIRQ-W} usage.
    swapper/1/0 [HC0[0]:SC1[1]:HE1:SE0] takes:
    ffff88810babe228 (&rxnet->peer_hash_lock){+.?.}-{3:3}, at: rxrpc_put_peer+0xcb/0x180
    {SOFTIRQ-ON-W} state was registered at:
      mark_usage+0x164/0x180
      __lock_acquire+0x544/0x990
      lock_acquire.part.0+0x103/0x280
      _raw_spin_lock+0x2f/0x40
      rxrpc_peer_keepalive_worker+0x144/0x440
      process_one_work+0x486/0x7c0
      process_scheduled_works+0x73/0x90
      worker_thread+0x1c8/0x2a0
      kthread+0x19b/0x1b0
      ret_from_fork+0x24/0x40
      ret_from_fork_asm+0x1a/0x30
    irq event stamp: 972402
    hardirqs last  enabled at (972402): [<ffffffff8244360e>] _raw_spin_unlock_irqrestore+0x2e/0x50
    hardirqs last disabled at (972401): [<ffffffff82443328>] _raw_spin_lock_irqsave+0x18/0x60
    softirqs last  enabled at (972300): [<ffffffff810ffbbe>] handle_softirqs+0x3ee/0x430
    softirqs last disabled at (972313): [<ffffffff810ffc54>] __irq_exit_rcu+0x44/0x110

    other info that might help us debug this:
     Possible unsafe locking scenario:
           CPU0
           ----
      lock(&rxnet->peer_hash_lock);
      <Interrupt>
        lock(&rxnet->peer_hash_lock);

     *** DEADLOCK ***
    1 lock held by swapper/1/0:
     #0: ffffffff83576be0 (rcu_callback){....}-{0:0}, at: rcu_lock_acquire+0x7/0x30

    stack backtrace:
    CPU: 1 UID: 0 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/1 Tainted: G            E      6.13.0-rc5-build2+ #1223
    Tainted: [E]=UNSIGNED_MODULE
    Hardware name: ASUS All Series/H97-PLUS, BIOS 2306 10/09/2014
    Call Trace:
     <IRQ>
     dump_stack_lvl+0x57/0x80
     print_usage_bug.part.0+0x227/0x240
     valid_state+0x53/0x70
     mark_lock_irq+0xa5/0x2f0
     mark_lock+0xf7/0x170
     mark_usage+0xe1/0x180
     __lock_acquire+0x544/0x990
     lock_acquire.part.0+0x103/0x280
     _raw_spin_lock+0x2f/0x40
     rxrpc_put_peer+0xcb/0x180
     afs_free_addrlist+0x46/0x90 [kafs]
     rcu_do_batch+0x2d2/0x640
     rcu_core+0x2f7/0x350
     handle_softirqs+0x1ee/0x430

RECORDS.description_main:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

hwmon: (asus-ec-sensors) check sensor index in read_string()

Prevent a potential invalid memory access when the requested sensor
is not found.

find_ec_sensor_index() may return a negative value (e.g. -ENOENT),
but its result was used without checking, which could lead to
undefined behavior when passed to get_sensor_info().

Add a proper check to return -EINVAL if sensor_index is negative.

Found by Linux Verification Center (linuxtesting.org) with SVACE.

[groeck: Return error code returned from find_ec_sensor_index]

RECORDS.description_main:
An improper Input Validation vulnerability allows injecting arbitrary values of the NAS configuration file in ASUSTOR ADM. This could potentially lead to system misconfiguration and break the format of the configuation file, causing the NAS to exhibit unexpected behavior.
This issue affects ADM: from 4.1 before 4.3.1.R5A1.
